prefill.scope: Instrumented forward includes actual producer hooks, diagnostic CPU copies and selected-device code emission when supplied. CPU syndrome/position packets are constructed afterward. Full raw KV remains resident.

capture.scope: Full device KV capture with CPU export; no encoded-cache attention or offload

producer_audit.rope_position_rule: contiguous absolute positions starting at zero
producer_audit.replay_device: original producer device; actual loaded Qwen3 apply_rotary_pos_emb
producer_audit.on_tile_stage: attention_forward_post_hook; before decoder layer resumes and root model returns
producer_audit.scope: Read-only inside-forward hooks; only fixed selected tile intersections exported. Hidden and projection tensors are temporary diagnostics, not free reconstruction state. Model retains full raw cache. No speed, capacity, compressed attention or serving result is implied.

inline_side_codes.scope: Actual synchronous attention on_tile callbacks; includes diagnostic staging and all requested hint encoders. IDs are later bitpacked. Full raw KV remains resident; no isolated prefill-overhead claim.

measurement.scope: Frozen-exponent control, actual reopened CRC-framed packets and indexed container; no neural prerequisite/prediction hashes. Synchronized staging/round-trip wall time, one pass.

accounting.scope: Sample packet bytes measured; all full-cache and concurrency results are ESTIMATES

sample.scope: MEASURED: actual sampled raw and complete packet bytes

state.charging_rule: max(serialized_bytes, resident_bytes) per family, then sum both families

full_cache_estimate.scope: ESTIMATE: sampled packet/raw ratio scaled to full raw cache; full decoder state charged once

concurrent_shared_state_estimates.scope: ESTIMATE: decoder state shared once across compatible contexts

break_even.scope: ESTIMATE: identical payload ratio and compatible shared decoder state
break_even.target_reduction_rule: greater than or equal to target

limitations: Sample extrapolation assumes the measured ratio represents the full cache; no confidence bound is implied.
Concurrency arithmetic assumes one compatible neural state and one compatible anchor state are shared across contexts.
Byte arithmetic does not establish GPU allocator use, materialization latency, attention compatibility or serving concurrency.

coding_summary.interpretation: Actual retained short-group counts distinguish exercised syndrome recovery from exact raw escapes. Error histograms include rejected candidates. Code-use ablations, not short-group presence alone, test dependence on the code.

measurement.scope: Actual independent pages and reopened indexed container; CPU packet coder and selected-device bit prediction. All raw group escapes and side codes retained; no whole-page fallback.

limitations: Sample extrapolation assumes the measured ratio represents the full cache; no confidence bound is implied.

selection.rule: Minimum complete DEV packet/raw ratio scaled to prespecified max requested TEST length, plus max(serialized,resident) full state; lexicographic tie break. TEST never replaces this selection.

generation_check_scope.frozen_exponent_control_scope: Every measured anchor page is independently serialized/restored and checked by the existing exponent baseline; no separate full-prefix continuation is run for this control.
